reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through a newly extracted linkSyncServerAccount/importLinkedAccount shared with the existing providers and the download reuses a generalised downloadProviderTransactions, though the pluggy/enableBanking download copies remain untouched.

duplication.why: Instead of adding a sixth copy of the link and download functions the diff collapses the existing copies into shared helpers; only the near-identical pluggy/enableBanking download functions remain duplicated (pre-existing).

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and the account type in types/models, matching where each provider's pieces live.

scope.why: Beyond adding Fintegra, the diff refactors the SimpleFin, PluggyAi, Akahu, EnableBanking and GoCardless link paths, a sizeable unrequested change to existing providers.

maintainability.why: One link path is easier to own, but the helper carries an options bag (fileId, tables, bankKey) and an 'in'-check chain for the bank key that make the preserved per-provider differences somewhat implicit.
